Mark will be at Presidio from 6:45PM to 9:00PM. You'd like to meet Mark for a minimum of 60 minutes. Joseph will be at Russian Hill from 4:45PM to 9:30PM. You'd like to meet Joseph for a minimum of 60 minutes.

- The schedule must account for all travel times and constraints using SMT
